description: This Java class 'SecurityTestUtils' provides utility methods for testing security-related functionalities within the Book Project. It primarily contains methods to fetch and insert a test user into the user repository, facilitating testing scenarios involving user authentication and data setup.

classes.name: SecurityTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class for testing security-related functionality, such as retrieving and inserting test users into the repository.

methods.name: getTestUser
methods.description: Fetches a test user with a predefined email from the repository; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: insertTestUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new test user with a predefined email and password into the repository.
